notes: `דָבָר אֵין־לָהֶם` divides as rule 43 directs: *had* on the `לְ`, *they* on its suffix, *no* on the existential and *dealings* on the noun.
`אֲשֶׁר לְבֵית־רְחוֹב` gives *lieth by* to the belonging `לְ` under rule 49's relational-verb sentence, headed on the English preposition.
`בָהּ` → *therein* is one two-morpheme fusion under rule 22.
